expected_closure.closure_notes: Large misclosure (70 ft) indicates this pre-survey legal description has inherent geometric inconsistencies. The bearings and distances as written in the deed do not form a closed polygon. This is the older (pre-survey) description used in the 2005 Lynch-to-Lynch trust transfer. Later deeds (8566, 9701) use a surveyor-corrected description with different bearing on call 1 (S 54 vs S 64), different distances on calls 4 and 5, and different bearing on call 5.

call_1_bearing.description: Call 1 bearing must be S 64 (not S 54) - this is the pre-survey description. Later surveyed deeds use S 54.

call_5_bearing.description: Call 5 bearing must be N 46°46'25" W (not N 47°08'20" W as in surveyed versions)

call_4_distance.description: Call 4 distance must be 279.48 ft (not 280.55 ft as in surveyed versions)

traverse_closes.description: Traverse does NOT close - 70 ft misclosure from inherent description errors

common_failure_modes.symptom: Misclosure of ~70 ft on 5 extracted calls
common_failure_modes.cause: This is expected behavior - the pre-survey legal description has geometric inconsistencies that cannot be resolved without a field survey
common_failure_modes.fix: Not a parser error - document this as a known non-closing deed in ground truth

common_failure_modes.symptom: S 54 extracted instead of S 64 on call 1
common_failure_modes.cause: OCR misread or confusion with the surveyed versions (8566, 9701) which use S 54
common_failure_modes.fix: Verify against the actual PDF scan - this deed clearly states S 64

notes: Chain-of-title deed for 26 Chews Landing Rd. Grantor: Dennis J. Lynch and Phyllis A. Lynch (50% interest). Grantee: Dennis J. Lynch and Phyllis A. Lynch as tenants in common (25% each). Dated April 11, 2005. Consideration: $1.00. Block 79.01, Lot 6. This uses the OLDER (pre-survey) legal description with S 64°22'25" W on call 1, different from the surveyed version (S 54°22'25" W) used in later deeds. Prior conveyance: Deed Book 5056, page 813.
